lineup.name: Shark Derby
lineup.line: Two laps of the lake. The sharks are only rubber, but they bonk hard.

lineup.name: Sauna Showdown
lineup.line: The benches are warm and the stove is hungry. Last one in wins.

lineup.name: Floe Sumo
lineup.line: Everyone onto a melting ice floe. Shove, slip and stay dry.

lineup.name: Bucket Brigade
lineup.line: A pond, a barrel each and forty seconds. Fill it to the brim!

lineup.name: Melon Run
lineup.line: A giant watermelon is rolling down the hill. Run!

lineup.name: Pepper Panic
lineup.line: Mild, hot or ghost: eat what lands on your plate. Most peppers wins.

lineup.name: Log Carry
lineup.line: Three friends, one big log, a long path. Keep in step and keep it up.
